question: Where did the Special Olympics World Games 2019 take place?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Abu Dhabi, UAE.**__

• The 2019 Special Olympics World Summer Games was **the first Special Olympics games to take place in the Middle East.**
 
• **India** comes back with a huge tally of **368 medals as the Special Olympics World Games 2019** in Abu Dhabi.
 
• India produce history in UAE by **scooping 85 gold, 154 silver, and 129 bronze.**
